[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 25
- Description: Deploy + live smoke test: oracle-advisory rate-limiter fix (PR #416)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/416
  
  Details:
  Deployed and verified PR #416 ("fix: oracle-advisory rate limit collapsed every visitor into one IP bucket").
  
  Root cause confirmed in code: `_real_client_ip()` in app/main.py only used `request.client.host`, which is ALWAYS the loopback (127.0.0.1) behind nginx — so every /oracle-advisory visitor collapsed into one shared rate-limit bucket, making the "1 req per 2s per IP" limit effectively global and causing false 429s ("oracle not returning a reading") for fresh visitors. The fix reads X-Forwarded-For's first entry (falling back to X-Real-IP, then client.host).
  
  Verification performed:
  - Confirmed PR #416 merged 2026-09-09 07:28:58 UTC; box HEAD at /opt/truesight_autopilot = 371b8fc (merge commit); uvicorn (PID 1182429) restarted 07:29:41 UTC, 23s after code mtime — service running the fix.
  - Live smoke test 1 (the bug scenario): two /oracle-advisory calls back-to-back with DIFFERENT X-Forwarded-For values (203.0.113.10 then 198.51.100.77) → both HTTP 200 with real readings, no cross-429.
  - Live smoke test 2 (negative control): two CONCURRENT same-IP requests → HTTP 200 + HTTP 429 (per-IP 1-per-2s limit still enforced; limiter not disabled).
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 0
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
